acceptanceCriteria: A1 Policy Planner requirements are resolved from repository policy and Work Item policy when present and are bound into the actual verification plan receipt
A2 Actual tier and assurance are checked against the policy requirement and an unsatisfied T3 or ProviderVerified requirement fails closed before evidence is recorded
A3 pr merge and release stages require a valid base revision at the execution boundary while task remains base-revision independent
A4 Plan receipt binds repository identity Work Item identity stage base revision policy references affected paths and dependency confidence without inventing unknown facts
A5 Regression tests cover policy route success and unsatisfied tier assurance plus missing base revision and receipt tampering
A6 Existing no-policy repositories retain current behavior and tri-language route docs state protocol capability versus lifecycle integration
goal: Integrate Policy Planner output into verify and lifecycle evidence; bind required tier assurance policy refs affected facts and base revision into the plan receipt; reject unsatisfied policy routes fail-closed.
intent: Connect policy-derived verification requirements and stage facts to the real CLI and Repository verification route so Runtime evidence cannot claim a weaker tier or missing base revision.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A declared policy requirement is bound to the verification plan receipt.
T3 or ProviderVerified requirements stop before completion evidence is recorded.
pr, merge, and release routes reject a missing base revision.
A tampered plan receipt cannot become a green Outcome.
